run_findings.control26_nonregression: Strict zero-residual-executor, zero-optional-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost acceptance remains authoritative; control25 relaxation is not imported.
run_findings.openhands_r6_revision: Prior R6 marker candidate is refuted as apply-ready because incremental recovery assignments can autosave an intermediate HEAD and generation-clean later same-generation markers; this is a candidate flaw, not an upstream OpenHands bug.
run_findings.openhands_r7_shape: Complete marker-chain validation must precede all public state mutation; one final base snapshot then cleanup. Source-equivalent R7 model PASS 11/11. Exact v1.44.1 source confirms _save_base_state is write-guarded, __setattr__ autosaves public changes, and __exit__ flushes dirty state even on exceptional exit, so a dedicated single-snapshot commit seam is required.
run_findings.mcp_csharp_boundary: C# SDK v2.2.0 remains the inspected Tasks runtime with a durable-create/volatile-schedule restart gap and no supported public existing-task/full-current-CallTool-pipeline re-entry seam in the exact surfaces examined; source-equivalent harness PASS 8/8.
run_findings.mcp_python_boundary: Latest Python SDK v2.1.1 (published 2026-08-25, commit 0921d94a74db900dccd2d534842aa7b6160542d2) explicitly states the official 2026-07-28 Tasks extension is not implemented yet; Task names are types-only. It is not a second runtime comparator.
run_findings.mcp_typescript_boundary: Current TypeScript server 2.0.0 changelog says the 2025 experimental task feature remains removed; restored task wire types are interoperability-only. This is secondary wire/runtime boundary evidence, not promoted to release-pinned modern task orchestration.
run_findings.cross_sdk_scope: Task wire/type vocabulary is not evidence of durable task orchestration. The C# restart/re-entry finding cannot yet be generalized cross-SDK because the other official SDKs inspected do not expose a comparable released Tasks runtime.
run_findings.phase1_boundary: All research/model/evidence persistence in this run was Chat-native, used no hosted runner/Codespaces/artifact/LFS/package/cloud-credit feature, and had zero incremental monetary cost. Missing runtime/upstream capabilities remain unresolved children, never accepted handoffs.
